# Norfolk Heating & Cooling

> Norfolk Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Norfolk, Norfolk County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (548) 708-8109  |  Email: contact@norfolkheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://norfolkheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Norfolk, Simcoe, Port Dover, Delhi, Waterford, Port Rowan, Turkey Point
